name: doc-align
description: Sign-off and alignment platform for Google Docs

scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build:extension:e2e && pnpm --filter @doc-align/e2e run test
scripts.test:e2e:headed: pnpm run build:extension:e2e && pnpm --filter @doc-align/e2e run test:headed
scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm run build-all && gcloud run deploy doc-align-api --source . --project doc-align-staging --region us-central1 --allow-unauthenticated
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm run build-all && gcloud run deploy doc-align-api --source . --project doc-align --region us-central1 --allow-unauthenticated
